name: com.xin.unity-broker-probe
description: Editor-only probe for the unity-job-guard broker (xin-unity-tools). Writes Library/UnityBrokerProbe/state.json with the editor's real state (epoch, compiles, Play, unsaved scenes, busy long runners, MCP actions) and keeps automatic asset refresh off so only explicit refreshes compile. No compile-time references: everything project- or package-specific is reached by reflection.
